settings.heading: The making
settings.content: Made to order, one at a time, and numbered to the edition. Printed, bound, or poured when you claim it — allow 3–5 days before shipping.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: It ships the moment it's finished, and it took the long way on purpose. Gracious, calm returns within 30 days — write to the house and we'll sort it.

settings.preorder_fulfillment: A preorder, charged today at [price]. Packed carefully by the house and sent the long way when it's ready. Nothing here waits in a warehouse.
